BPSSC Bihar Police Sub Inspector SI Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) has released the notification for the recruitment of Sub Inspector SI Posts on the official website of the Bihar Police BPSSC. As per the notification, Online application process for BPSSC Bihar Police Sub Inspector SI Recruitment 2026 will start on 09 july 2026 2026 & the candidates can apply till 09 August 2026. There is a total of 150 vacancies has been issued in the Bihar Police BPSSC Recruitment 2026 for the Sub Inspector SI Posts. Candidates must check the details for BPSSC Bihar Police Sub Inspector SI Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 July 2026
  • Last Date : 09 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 09 August 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Available Soon

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

The last date to apply is 09 August 2026.
